section_summary.extract_value: This section is an appendix presenting the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2) instrument in its final version. It provides directions for participants using a 5-point Likert scale (Never to Always) and specifies the scoring procedure as averaging responses to Items 1–10. No empirical study data, participant demographics, or correlation analyses are included in this appendix.
